mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName, role, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(permissions_json, '$')) AS permissionsJson, enabled FROM auth_users WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id AS userId, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName, role, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(permissions_json, '$')) AS permissionsJson, enabled FROM auth_users WHERE username = #{username} AND enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_users ( user_id, username, password_hash, display_name, role, permissions_json, enabled ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{role}, #{permissionsJson}, #{enabled} )
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = 1
